portal_description:
The Ansible plug-ins for Red Hat Developer Hub provides an Ansible-specific portal experience for Red Hat Developer Hub. It provides step-by-step learning paths and interactive labs, push-button automation Ansible content creation, development tool integrations, and other opinionated resources curated by Red Hat Ansible.

The Ansible plug-ins for Red Hat Developer Hub has been updated to 1.2.0 in this release.
